```{r setup, include=FALSE}
#packages
library(here)

folder_path <- "01_data/inital_raw_database_downloads/"

source(here("", "my_keys.R"))


cleanup_text_encoding <- function(text) {
  
  text <- as.character(text)
  
  text %>%
    
    stri_enc_toutf8() %>%
    
    gsub(pattern = "<[^>]+>", replacement = "", x = .) %>%
    
    stri_replace_all_regex("A{1,4}[\u00A0-\u00BF\u2000-\u206F\u2070-\u209F\u20A0-\u20CF\u2100-\u214F]+", "") %>%
    stri_replace_all_regex("A{2,}[0-9\\W]+", "") %>%
    stri_replace_all_regex("[A-Za-z]?\x2F[0-9]|I1\x2F4", "u") %>% 
    
    stri_replace_all_regex("([a-z])as\\b", "$1's") %>%
    stri_replace_all_regex("([a-z])a([A-Z])", "$1 $2") %>%
    
    stri_replace_all_regex("^(.{10,})\\1+$", "$1") %>%
    
    stri_trans_nfkc() %>%
    stri_trans_general(id = "Latin-ASCII") %>%
    
    stri_replace_all_regex("[\x22\x27`“”‘’()\\[\\]\\{\\}]", "") %>%
    
    stri_replace_all_regex("[^a-zA-Z0-9\\s.,!?:;\\-]", "") %>%
    stri_replace_all_regex("\\s+", " ") %>%
    trimws() %>%
    enc2utf8()
}
```


```{r}

if (file.exists(here::here(folder_path, "prisma_df.csv"))) {
  
   prisma_df <- read.csv(here::here(folder_path, "prisma_df.csv"), row.names=1)
   
  } else {
    
   prisma_df <- data.frame(
      step = c("initial_download", "selected_works", "no_title", 
               "selected_works_w_all_titles", "unique_titles", 
               "originally_english_titles", "originally_non_english_titles", 
               "originally_english_abstracts", "originally_non_english_abstracts", 
               "n_possible_duplicates", "duplicates_removed", "final_cleaned", 
               "percent_unique"),
      Scopus = NA,
      WoS = NA,
      OpenAlex = NA
    ) %>%
      `rownames<-`(.$step)
       
  }

```



# Scopus

```{r, eval = FALSE}
raw_scopus <- read.csv(here(paste0(folder_path, "/Scopus"),
                           "raw_full_scopus_export.csv"))
unique(raw_scopus$type)
```

```{r, fig.width=8, fig.height=12, eval = FALSE}

raw_scopus %>%
  group_by(publication_year) %>%
  summarize(n_works = n()) %>%
  arrange(desc(publication_year)) 

raw_scopus %>%
  group_by(publication_year) %>%
  summarize(n_works = n()) %>%
  arrange(publication_year) %>%
  mutate(publication_year = as.factor(publication_year)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = publication_year, y = n_works))+
    geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
    theme_classic() +
    coord_flip()
```

```{r, eval = FALSE}
raw_scopus %>%
```

```{r, eval = FALSE}
scopus_selected_works <- read.csv(here(paste0(folder_path, "Scopus"),
                                       "raw_full_scopus_export.csv")) %>%
  { prisma_df["initial_download", "Scopus"] <<- nrow(.); . } %>%
  filter(type %in% c("Article", "Book Chapter", 
                     "Review", "Report", "Data Paper")) %>%
  { prisma_df["selected_works", "Scopus"] <<- nrow(.); . }

scopus_selected_works %>%
  filter(is.na(title) | title == "") %>%
  { prisma_df["no_title", "Scopus"] <<- nrow(.); . } %>%
  write.csv(., here(paste0(folder_path, "/Scopus"), "scopus_export_notitle.csv")) 


cleaned_scopus_noabs <- scopus_selected_works %>%
  filter(!is.na(title) & title != "") %>%
  rbind(., dplyr::select(read.csv(here(paste0(folder_path, "/Scopus"),
                                       "scopus_export_notitle_added.csv")), -X)) %>%
  filter(type %in% c("Article", "Book Chapter", 
                     "Review", "Report", "Data Paper")) %>% #in case any were changes during manual data entry
  { prisma_df["selected_works_w_all_titles", "Scopus"] <<- nrow(.); . } %>%
  arrange(title)  

write.csv(cleaned_scopus_noabs, here(paste0(folder_path, "/Scopus"), 
                                  "scopus_export_works_w_all_titles.csv"),
            row.names = FALSE) 

cleaned_scopus_noabs %>%
  dplyr::select(title) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  { prisma_df["unique_titles", "Scopus"] <<- nrow(.); . } %>%
  write.csv(., here(paste0(folder_path, "/Scopus"), "scopus_raw_uncleaned_titles.csv"),
            row.names = FALSE)

write.csv(prisma_df, here::here(folder_path, "prisma_df.csv"),
          row.names = TRUE)

```





```{r, eval=FALSE}

scopus_raw_uncleaned_titles <- read.csv(here(paste0(folder_path, "/Scopus"), "scopus_raw_uncleaned_titles.csv"))  %>%
  mutate(
        tidy_original_title = cleanup_text_encoding(title),
        language = cld2::detect_language(tidy_original_title)) %>%
  mutate(english_title = if_else(language == "en", tidy_original_title, NA))


scopus_raw_english_titles <- scopus_raw_uncleaned_titles %>%
   filter(language ==  "en") %>%
  { prisma_df["originally_english_titles", "Scopus"] <<- nrow(.); . }

scopus_raw_nonenglish_titles <- scopus_raw_uncleaned_titles %>%
   filter(language !=  "en" | is.na(language)) %>%
  { prisma_df["originally_non_english_titles", "Scopus"] <<- nrow(.); . } %>%
  mutate(english_title = google_translate(tidy_original_title, target_language = "en")) %>%
  mutate(english_title = if_else(is.na(english_title) | english_title == "",
                                 google_translate(tidy_original_title, target_language = "en"),
                                 english_title))%>%
  mutate(english_title = if_else(is.na(english_title) | english_title == "",
                                 google_translate(title, target_language = "en"),
                                 english_title)) %>%
  mutate(english_title = if_else(nchar(english_title) <= 5,
                                 google_translate(title, target_language = "en"),
                                 english_title))


write.csv(prisma_df, here::here(folder_path, "prisma_df.csv"),
          row.names = TRUE)


scopus_translated_titles <- rbind(scopus_raw_english_titles,
                               scopus_raw_nonenglish_titles)

write.csv(scopus_translated_titles,
          file = here(paste0(folder_path, "/Scopus"),
                      "scopus_export_translated_titles.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)

nrow(scopus_translated_titles) == nrow(scopus_raw_uncleaned_titles)


check_scopus_translations <- scopus_translated_titles %>%
   filter(is.na(english_title)| english_title == "")


scopus_export_en <- read.csv(here(paste0(folder_path, "/Scopus"), 
                                  "scopus_export_works_w_all_titles.csv")) %>%
  left_join(dplyr::select(scopus_translated_titles, c(title, english_title)), 
            by = "title")

write.csv(scopus_export_en,
          file = here(paste0(folder_path, "/Scopus"),
                      "scopus_export_en.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)
```




```{r, eval = FALSE}

scopus_export_en <- read.csv(here(paste0(folder_path, "/Scopus"), 
                                           "scopus_export_en.csv"))
scopus_export_en %>%
   filter(is.na(english_title)| english_title == "")

scopus_export_wkey <- scopus_export_en %>%
  mutate(english_title_key = english_title %>%
           str_to_lower() %>%
           str_remove_all("<[^>]+>") %>%
           str_remove_all("[^a-z0-9]") %>%
           str_remove_all("\\s"),
         first_author = authorships)
  
 
duplicate_keys <- scopus_export_wkey %>%
  group_by(english_title_key) %>%
  count() %>%
  filter(n > 1) %>%
  mutate(id_to_keep = NA)

single_records_keys <- scopus_export_wkey %>%
  group_by(english_title_key) %>%
  count() %>%
  filter(n == 1) 

for(i in 1:nrow(duplicate_keys)){
  
  xx_dup <- scopus_export_wkey %>%
    filter(english_title_key == duplicate_keys$english_title_key[i])
  
  xx_distinct <- xx_dup %>%
    dplyr::select(first_author) %>%
    filter(!is.na(first_author)) %>%
    distinct()
  
  if(nrow(xx_distinct) == 1){
    duplicate_keys$id_to_keep[i] <- xx_dup$id[1]
  } else {
    next
  }
  
}

duplicate_keys_duplicate_citations <- duplicate_keys %>%
  filter(!is.na(id_to_keep))

duplicate_keys_NOT_duplicate_citations <- duplicate_keys %>%
  filter(is.na(id_to_keep))


scopus_duplicates <- scopus_export_wkey %>%
  filter(english_title_key %in% duplicate_keys$english_title_key) %>%
  { prisma_df["n_possible_duplicates", "Scopus"] <<- nrow(.); . } 



scopus_single_records <- scopus_export_wkey %>%
  filter(english_title_key %in% single_records_keys$english_title_key |
         english_title_key %in% duplicate_keys_NOT_duplicate_citations | 
         (id %in% duplicate_keys_duplicate_citations$id_to_keep)) %>%
  { prisma_df["duplicates_removed", "Scopus"] <<- (nrow(scopus_export_wkey) - nrow(.)); . } %>%
  { prisma_df["final_cleaned", "Scopus"] <<- nrow(.); . } 


write.csv(prisma_df, here::here(folder_path, "prisma_df.csv"),
          row.names = TRUE)

write.csv(scopus_single_records, here(paste0(folder_path, "/Scopus"), "scopus_export_nodups.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(scopus_single_records, here(folder_path, "scopus_final_cleaned.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r, eval = FALSE}

openalex_export_en <- read.csv(here(paste0(folder_path, "/OpenAlex"), 
                                           "openalex_export_en.csv"))
openalex_export_en %>%
   filter(is.na(english_title)| english_title == "")

openalex_export_wkey <- openalex_export_en %>%
  mutate(english_title_key = english_title %>%
           str_to_lower() %>%
           str_remove_all("<[^>]+>") %>%
           str_remove_all("[^a-z0-9]") %>%
           str_remove_all("\\s"),
         authorships_cleaned = authorships %>%
           str_replace_all("<p>|<sup>", "") %>%
           str_replace_all("</p>|</sup>", ";") %>%
           str_remove_all("(?i)\\b(PhD|Dr|Prof)\\b|\\(\\s*\\)") %>%
           str_remove_all("[¹²³⁴⁵⁶⁷⁸⁹⁰0-9■*#\\\\$|<>():⎜│⎟⎪⎮⎩\t\\p{So}\\p{Sm}]") %>%
           str_replace_all("^[[:punct:]\\s\\p{So}\\p{Sm}]+|[[:punct:]\\s\\p{So}\\p{Sm}]+$", "") %>%
           str_squish())  %>%
  tidyr::separate(col = authorships_cleaned, into = c("first_author"), sep = ";")
  
 
duplicate_keys <- openalex_export_wkey %>%
  group_by(english_title_key) %>%
  count() %>%
  filter(n > 1) %>%
  mutate(id_to_keep = NA)

single_records_keys <- openalex_export_wkey %>%
  group_by(english_title_key) %>%
  count() %>%
  filter(n == 1) 

for(i in 1:nrow(duplicate_keys)){
  
  xx_dup <- openalex_export_wkey %>%
    filter(english_title_key == duplicate_keys$english_title_key[i])
  
  xx_distinct <- xx_dup %>%
    dplyr::select(first_author) %>%
    filter(!is.na(first_author)) %>%
    distinct()
  
  if(nrow(xx_distinct) == 1){
    duplicate_keys$id_to_keep[i] <- xx_dup$id[1]
  } else {
    next
  }
  
}

duplicate_keys_duplicate_citations <- duplicate_keys %>%
  filter(!is.na(id_to_keep))

duplicate_keys_NOT_duplicate_citations <- duplicate_keys %>%
  filter(is.na(id_to_keep))


openalex_duplicates <- openalex_export_wkey %>%
  filter(english_title_key %in% duplicate_keys$english_title_key) %>%
  { prisma_df["n_possible_duplicates", "OpenAlex"] <<- nrow(.); . } 



openalex_single_records <- openalex_export_wkey %>%
  filter(english_title_key %in% single_records_keys$english_title_key |
         english_title_key %in% duplicate_keys_NOT_duplicate_citations | 
         (id %in% duplicate_keys_duplicate_citations$id_to_keep)) %>%
  { prisma_df["duplicates_removed", "OpenAlex"] <<- (nrow(openalex_export_wkey) - nrow(.)); . } %>%
  { prisma_df["final_cleaned", "OpenAlex"] <<- nrow(.); . } 


write.csv(prisma_df, here::here(folder_path, "prisma_df.csv"),
          row.names = TRUE)

write.csv(openalex_single_records, here(paste0(folder_path, "/OpenAlex"), "openalex_export_nodups.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(openalex_single_records, here(folder_path, "openalex_final_cleaned.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)
```

# Combining Databases


```{r, eval=FALSE}
scopus_final_cleaned <- read.csv(here(folder_path, "scopus_final_cleaned.csv")) %>%
  mutate(database = "Scopus") %>%
  tidyr::separate(col = first_author, into = c("family", "given"), sep=" ") %>%
  mutate(family_cleaned = family %>%
           stri_trans_general(id = "Any-Latin; Latin-ASCII") %>%
           str_to_title() %>%
           str_replace_all(regex("\\W+"), ""),
         given_initial = substring(given, 1, 1)%>%
           stri_trans_general(id = "Any-Latin; Latin-ASCII") %>%
           str_to_title(),
         first_author_cleaned = if_else(is.na(authorships), NA,
                                        paste0(family_cleaned, " ", given_initial, ".")))

wos_final_cleaned <- read.csv(here(folder_path, "wos_final_cleaned.csv")) %>%
  mutate(database = "Web of Science") %>%
  tidyr::separate(col = first_author, into = c("family", "given"), sep=" ") %>%
  mutate(family_cleaned = family %>%
           stri_trans_general(id = "Any-Latin; Latin-ASCII") %>%
           str_to_title() %>%
           str_replace_all(regex("\\W+"), ""),
         given_initial = substring(given, 1, 1)%>%
           stri_trans_general(id = "Any-Latin; Latin-ASCII") %>%
           str_to_title(),
         first_author_cleaned = if_else(is.na(authorships), NA,
                                        paste0(family_cleaned, " ", given_initial, ".")),
        title = case_when(
             doi =="10.5943/mycosphere/13/1/6" ~ "Ten important forest fungal pathogens: a review on their emergence and biology",
             TRUE ~ title),
         english_title = case_when(
             doi =="10.5943/mycosphere/13/1/6" ~ "Ten important forest fungal pathogens: a review on their emergence and biology",
             TRUE ~ english_title),
          english_title_key = english_title %>%
             str_to_lower() %>%
             str_remove_all("<[^>]+>") %>%
             str_remove_all("[^a-z0-9]") %>%
             str_remove_all("\\s")
        )

openalex_final_cleaned_w_abstracts <- read.csv(here(folder_path, "openalex_final_cleaned.csv")) %>%
  mutate(
    database = "OpenAlex",
    first_author = str_replace(first_author, "^[[:punct:]\\s]+", ""),
    family = case_when(
        str_detect(first_author, ",") ~ str_extract(first_author, "^[^,]+"), 
        TRUE ~ str_extract(first_author, "\\S+$")
      ) %>% 
        str_replace("[[:punct:]\\s]+$", ""),
    given = case_when(
        str_detect(first_author, ",") ~ str_replace(first_author, "^[^,]+,\\s*", ""), 
        str_detect(first_author, "\\s") ~ str_remove(first_author, "\\s+\\S+$"),
        TRUE ~ NA
      ) %>% 
        str_replace("[[:punct:]\\s]+$", "")
    ) %>%
  mutate(family_cleaned = family %>%
           str_replace("[[:punct:]\\s]+$", "") %>%
           stri_trans_general(id = "Any-Latin; Latin-ASCII") %>%
           str_to_title() %>%
           str_replace_all(regex("\\W+"), ""),
         given_initial = str_replace(given, "[[:punct:]\\s]+$", "") %>%
           substring(., 1, 1) %>%
           stri_trans_general(id = "Any-Latin; Latin-ASCII") %>%
           str_to_title(),
         first_author_cleaned = if_else(is.na(authorships), NA,
            str_trim(paste0(coalesce(family_cleaned, ""), 
              if_else(!is.na(given_initial) & given_initial != "", paste0(" ", given_initial, "."), "")
            )))
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(-first_author)
  
 
full_uncollapsed_lookup <- scopus_final_cleaned %>%
  bind_rows(wos_final_cleaned, openalex_final_cleaned_w_abstracts) %>%
  mutate(english_title_standardized = english_title %>%
            stri_trans_general(id = "Any-Latin; Latin-ASCII") %>% #latin characters 
            str_to_sentence() %>% #sentance case to standardize
            stri_replace_all_regex("[^a-zA-Z0-9\\s.,!?:;\\-]", "") %>% #only keeps a-z, A-Z, 0-9, whitespace (spaces, tabs, newlines), .,!?:;:-
            str_replace_all("([:?.,;-])(?:\\s+\\1)+", "\\1") %>% #spaced out repeats
            str_replace_all("([:?.,;-])\\1+", "\\1") %>% #removes repeated punctuation
            str_replace_all("([:?.,;-])[/:?.,;-]+", "\\1") %>% #removed mixed punctuation
            str_replace_all("\\s+-\\s+", " ") %>% #removes spaces around hyphens
            str_replace_all("\\s+([;:])", "\\1") %>% #removes whitespace before ; or :
            str_replace_all("^[/:?.,;\\-\\s]+", "") %>% #removes leading punctuation (with their spaces)
            str_replace_all("\\s{2,}", " ") %>% #any double spaces are gone
            str_trim() %>% #trailing whitespace
            str_replace_all("[[:punct:]\\s]+$", ""), #trailing punctuation
        doi = str_to_lower(gsub("^https?://(dx\\.)?doi\\.org/", "", doi))
      ) 

no_title_key <- full_uncollapsed_lookup %>%
  filter(english_title_key == "" | is.na(english_title_key))

no_authors <- full_uncollapsed_lookup %>%
  filter(is.na(authorships))

write.csv(full_uncollapsed_lookup, here(folder_path, "combined_uncollapsed_lookup.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)
```


```{r, eval = FALSE}
full_uncollapsed_lookup <- read.csv(here(folder_path, "combined_uncollapsed_lookup.csv"))


work_ids <- full_uncollapsed_lookup %>%
  dplyr::select(doi, database, english_title_key) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  mutate(present = TRUE) %>%
  group_by(doi, english_title_key) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = database, values_from = present) %>%
  rename(WoS = 'Web of Science') %>%
  mutate(unique_for = case_when(
    is.na(Scopus) & is.na(WoS) & !is.na(OpenAlex) ~ "OpenAlex",
    is.na(Scopus) & !is.na(WoS) & is.na(OpenAlex) ~ "WoS",
    !is.na(Scopus) & is.na(WoS) & is.na(OpenAlex) ~ "Scopus",
    TRUE ~ "shared"
  )) %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("id") %>%
  mutate(id = paste0("id_", str_pad(id, 7, pad = "0")))
  

prisma_df["number_unique", "step"] <- "number_unique"

prisma_df["number_unique", "OpenAlex"] <- work_ids %>%
  filter(unique_for == "OpenAlex") %>%
  nrow(.) 
  
prisma_df["number_unique", "Scopus"] <- work_ids %>%
  filter(unique_for == "Scopus") %>%
  nrow(.)
  
  
prisma_df["number_unique", "WoS"] <- work_ids %>%
  filter(unique_for == "WoS") %>%
  nrow(.) 


prisma_df["percent_unique", "WoS"] <- round((prisma_df["number_unique", "WoS"] / 
  prisma_df["final_cleaned", "WoS"] )*100, 1)

prisma_df["percent_unique", "Scopus"] <- round((prisma_df["number_unique", "Scopus"] / 
  prisma_df["final_cleaned", "Scopus"] )*100, 1)

prisma_df["percent_unique", "OpenAlex"] <- round((prisma_df["number_unique", "OpenAlex"] / 
  prisma_df["final_cleaned", "OpenAlex"] )*100, 1)


prisma_df["database_proportion", "step"] <- "database_proportion"

prisma_df["database_proportion", "WoS"] <- round(prisma_df["final_cleaned", "WoS"] /
  sum(prisma_df["final_cleaned", "Scopus"], prisma_df["final_cleaned", "WoS"], prisma_df["final_cleaned", "OpenAlex"]), 2)

prisma_df["database_proportion", "Scopus"] <- round(prisma_df["final_cleaned", "Scopus"] /
  sum(prisma_df["final_cleaned", "Scopus"], prisma_df["final_cleaned", "WoS"], prisma_df["final_cleaned", "OpenAlex"]), 2)

prisma_df["database_proportion", "OpenAlex"] <- round(prisma_df["final_cleaned", "OpenAlex"] /
  sum(prisma_df["final_cleaned", "Scopus"], prisma_df["final_cleaned", "WoS"], prisma_df["final_cleaned", "OpenAlex"]), 2)

options(scipen=999)
write.csv(prisma_df, here::here(folder_path, "prisma_df.csv"),
          row.names = TRUE)

write.csv(work_ids, here(folder_path, "collapsed_with_official_IDs_no_abstracts.csv"),
```

# Manual website scraping

## export scraping strings

```{r, eval = FALSE}

missing_abstracts <- read.csv(here(paste0(folder_path, 
                                          "abstract_scraping/still_missing_abstracts"), 
                                   paste0("missing_abstracts.csv")))

dois_to_scrape <- unique(gsub("https://doi.org/", "", missing_abstracts$doi))

tibble(doi = dois_to_scrape) %>%
  mutate(batch = (row_number() - 1) %/% 1000 + 1) %>%
  group_by(batch) %>%
  summarise(
    doi_count = n(),
    wos_query = paste0('DO=("', paste(doi, collapse = '" OR "'), '")'),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  write.csv(., here(paste0(folder_path, "abstract_scraping/manual_scraping"), 
                    "wos_strings_to_scrape.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```
